title: Assistant Psychologist Roles: What the BPS Says You Should and Shouldn't Do

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们能赚到除了出卖时间换取金钱以外的收入，会怎样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家 Marianne Trent 博士，自 2019 年以来，我一直在开发被动和经常性收入来源。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一个令人兴奋的消息。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many program is now open for enrolment.
sentences.zh: Sophie Foote 的“一对多”项目现已开放报名。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships, and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己于 2022 年完成了该项目，此后也支持了两批心理学家走过他们的旅程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的附属链接加入，你将获得 Sophie 的奖励，以及我提供的独家支持套餐，无需额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的 WhatsApp 支持、四场小组智囊团会议、大师班、个性化指导、一份 Fortnum and Mason 的礼品，以及限时的一对一辅导奖励。

sentences.en: Enrolment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于 11 月 16 日星期一晚上 10 点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过描述中链接的我的奖励页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的奖励。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时为你解答。

sentences.en: What does the British Psychological Society say that an assistant psychologist should be doing?
sentences.zh: 英国心理学会认为助理心理学家应该做什么？

sentences.en: What do they say they should not be doing?
sentences.zh: 他们认为助理心理学家不应该做什么？

sentences.en: I am joined once again by Luke Meakin, an assistant psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 再次与我一起的是助理心理学家 Luke Meakin。

sentences.en: We are taking a look at the recent guidance put together by the BPS looking at how to recruit assistant psychologists.
sentences.zh: 我们正在审视英国心理学会（BPS）最近发布的关于如何招聘助理心理学家的指南。

sentences.en: It is an invigorating, lively, really interesting and helpful discussion.
sentences.zh: 这是一场令人振奋、生动、非常有趣且有益的讨论。

sentences.en: I hope you find it so useful.
sentences.zh: 希望你觉得它很有用。

sentences.en: Hi, welcome along to the Aspiring Psychologist podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 嗨，欢迎来到“有抱负的心理学家”播客。

sentences.en: I am Dr. Marianne Trent and I'm a qualified clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我是 Marianne Trent 博士，我是一名合格的临床心理学家。

sentences.en: It is my pleasure to bring you this close look at what goes on in the minds of qualified psychologists.
sentences.zh: 很高兴能带大家深入了解合格心理学家的内心世界。

sentences.en: And speaking to our guests, who I have just recorded this episode with and you're just about to meet again,
sentences.zh: 刚才我和嘉宾录制了这一集，你们马上就要见到他们了，与他们交谈，

sentences.en: It just reinvigorates my passion for this podcast, it really does, that it's making a difference, that it's appreciated,
sentences.zh: 这真的重新激发了我对这个播客的热情，确实如此，它正在产生影响，它得到了认可，

sentences.en: that you are getting access to really important, helpful conversations that you may or may not be getting access to in your immediate work or learning environment,
sentences.zh: 你们正在接触到非常重要、有益的对话，这些对话在你们日常的工作或学习环境中可能接触不到，

sentences.en: but that it can help shape you and your thinking and hopefully make your life working in mental health work better for you.
sentences.zh: 但它能帮助塑造你和你的思维，并希望让你的心理健康工作生活变得更好。

sentences.en: Let's dive in and I will catch you on the other side.
sentences.zh: 让我们开始吧，稍后见。

sentences.en: Hi, just want to welcome back to the podcast, Luke Meakin, assistant psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 嗨，欢迎回到播客，Luke Meakin，助理心理学家。

sentences.en: Hi, Luke.
sentences.zh: 嗨，Luke。

sentences.en: Lovely to have you back.
sentences.zh: 很高兴你能回来。

sentences.en: Hi, Marianne.
sentences.zh: 嗨，Marianne。

sentences.en: Thank you for having me back.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你邀请我回来。

sentences.en: It's a pleasure to be here again.
sentences.zh: 很高兴能再次来到这里。

sentences.en: Oh, I agree.
sentences.zh: 噢，我同意。

sentences.en: I was like, you know, when you're preparing for a day and you sometimes think, oh, I've got to do that.
sentences.zh: 我当时想，你知道，当你为一天做准备时，有时会想，噢，我得做那个。

sentences.en: Like today, I was like, oh, I get to see Luke again.
sentences.zh: 就像今天，我心想，噢，我又可以见到 Luke 了。

sentences.en: So like, it's a gestalt shift, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 所以这是一种格式塔转换，对吧？

sentences.en: Like, well, I was really looking forward to seeing you.
sentences.zh: 我是真的很期待见到你。

sentences.en: So thank you for being here.
sentences.zh: 所以谢谢你能来。

sentences.en: Of course.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: It's great to be back.
sentences.zh: 很高兴能回来。

sentences.en: And, you know, we're talking today again about assistant psychologists.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我们今天再次讨论助理心理学家的话题。

sentences.en: And since we met, pretty much as soon as we'd met, we messaged each other to say, oh, look,
sentences.zh: 自从我们见面后，几乎就在我们见面后，我们就互相发信息说，噢，看，

sentences.en: there's some guidance on the recruitment of assistant psychologists from the British Psychological Society now, the BPS.
sentences.zh: 英国心理学会（BPS）现在有了关于招聘助理心理学家的指南。

sentences.en: And obviously, when we met for our audience, it was last week.
sentences.zh: 显然，当我们为听众见面时，那是上周的事了。

sentences.en: For us, it was pretty much feels like a lifetime ago, but it was at the start of the summer.
sentences.zh: 对我们来说，感觉像是过了很久，但那是在夏天开始的时候。

sentences.en: And we were looking at the Association of Clinical Psychologists Guidance for Assistant Psychologists.
sentences.zh: 我们当时正在查看临床心理学家协会（ACP）针对助理心理学家的指南。

sentences.en: So we thought it might just be a really nice idea to kind of just compare and contrast, really.
sentences.zh: 所以我们觉得进行对比分析可能是一个非常好的主意。

sentences.en: So we're not going to go over too much of what we've gone over before.
sentences.zh: 所以我们不会过多重复之前讨论过的内容。

sentences.en: So people, if they haven't watched the first one, they might find it helpful to do that.
sentences.zh: 如果人们还没有看过第一集，他们可能会觉得看一看很有帮助。

sentences.en: It's called What is an Assistant Psychologist and What Do They Do?
sentences.zh: 那一集叫“什么是助理心理学家，他们做什么？”

sentences.en: And if you're looking for it and it's like years since it came out, it came out in October 2024.
sentences.zh: 如果你在找它，而且距离它发布已经过去几年了，它是 2024 年 10 月发布的。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think it was really quite frustrating and confusing that it came out maybe one or two days after we recorded.
sentences.zh: 是的，我觉得它在我们录制后一两天发布，确实让人感到沮丧和困惑。

sentences.en: So it is definitely good to have this time to discuss it because we've all in the industry been waiting for a while for the BPS to produce something.
sentences.zh: 所以现在有时间讨论它绝对是件好事，因为我们行业里的人都在等待 BPS 出台一些东西。

sentences.en: Yeah, we really have.
sentences.zh: 是的，确实如此。

sentences.en: And I think my first dismay with this was that I initially tried to download it this morning whilst I was eating breakfast,
sentences.zh: 我最初对它的不满是，我今天早上吃早餐时试着下载它，

sentences.en: but I couldn't do it from my tablet because you needed to be logged in.
sentences.zh: 但我无法从平板电脑上下载，因为需要登录。

sentences.en: So you needed to be a BPS member to access that.
sentences.zh: 所以你需要成为 BPS 会员才能访问它。

sentences.en: And that doesn't feel that inclusive, really, whereas the ACP one, I think I'm right in saying, was just a freely available online document.
sentences.zh: 这感觉不太包容，而 ACP 的指南，如果我没记错的话，是一份可以在线免费获取的文件。

sentences.en: So if anyone is working in a service and wanted to check what the BPS guidance is and they're not a member, they can't.
sentences.zh: 所以如果有人在服务机构工作，想查看 BPS 的指南，但他们不是会员，他们就无法查看。

sentences.en: And if anybody's looking to recruit, but they're not a BPS member, they can't necessarily access that readily.
sentences.zh: 如果有人想招聘，但他们不是 BPS 会员，他们也不一定能轻易获取该指南。

sentences.en: You know, they might be able to contact the BPS and see if they can get a copy.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们也许可以联系 BPS 看看能否拿到副本。

sentences.en: But yeah, that was just a little bit of a heart sync moment.
sentences.zh: 但是的，那确实让人心里咯噔了一下。

sentences.en: It delayed my processes, but also made me think about people trying to do right.
sentences.zh: 它拖慢了我的进度，也让我思考那些试图做正确事情的人。

sentences.en: You know, it's very tricky.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这非常棘手。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think you're totally right.
sentences.zh: 是的，我觉得你说得完全正确。

sentences.en: It's kind of indicative of how the BPS tend to work.
sentences.zh: 这在某种程度上反映了 BPS 的工作方式。

sentences.en: In my experience, you know, as you say, they put something out that's really helpful and they limit it straight away.
sentences.zh: 根据我的经验，正如你所说，他们发布了一些非常有用的东西，但马上又限制了它。

sentences.en: And the website, I don't know if you go on there often, I tend to go on there maybe once a month or if I'm trying to search particular documents, publications.
sentences.zh: 还有网站，我不知道你是否经常上去，我倾向于一个月去一次，或者当我试图搜索特定的文件、出版物时。

sentences.en: It's quite a cumbersome website, but it can be depending on the device you're using.
sentences.zh: 这是一个相当笨重的网站，具体取决于你使用的设备。

sentences.en: So luckily I was at work and I was able to get into it pretty easily.
sentences.zh: 所以幸运的是我在工作，能够很容易地进入它。

sentences.en: But I think if I was on an iPad, I think you use an iPad a lot.
sentences.zh: 但我想如果我用 iPad，我知道你经常用 iPad。

sentences.en: If I was on an iPad, I would have struggled.
sentences.zh: 如果我用 iPad，我会很吃力。

sentences.en: So it's definitely a bit of a barrier before the first hurdles even jump.
sentences.zh: 所以这绝对是在跨越第一个障碍之前的一个障碍。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think there is something about the restrictive element of BPS.
sentences.zh: 是的，我觉得 BPS 的限制性因素确实存在。

sentences.en: So I'd signed up for a course that I'd bought through there, but it's not a cheap course.
sentences.zh: 我报名参加了通过那里购买的一门课程，但那不是一门便宜的课程。

sentences.en: And I hadn't realised when I bought it that I only get six months access.
sentences.zh: 我购买时没意识到我只有六个月的访问权限。

sentences.en: And so, you know, I think it's nice to be able to get lifetime access and be able to go back and kind of engage with it again
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，我认为能够获得终身访问权限并能够回头再次参与其中是很好的，

sentences.en: or watch it when you've got more headspace or when you might be at a different stage of your learning journey to be able to take more from it.
sentences.zh: 或者当你更有空闲时间，或者当你处于学习旅程的不同阶段时观看它，以便从中获得更多收获。

sentences.en: And, yeah, that was a little bit annoying in terms of access too, I thought.
sentences.zh: 而且，是的，我觉得在访问权限方面也有一点烦人。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的，是的。

sentences.en: I found that when applying for the extra sort of divisions, the subdivisions.
sentences.zh: 我在申请额外的部门，即细分部门时也发现了这一点。

sentences.en: So I think I'm a member of the clinical psychology and psychosis, psychotic disorders, I suppose.
sentences.zh: 我想我是临床心理学和精神病学、精神障碍部门的成员，我想是这样。

sentences.en: And it's really, really difficult to access those things on the website after paying for admission into the subdivision.
sentences.zh: 在支付了进入细分部门的费用后，在网站上访问这些内容真的非常非常困难。

sentences.en: And like yourself, like you just said, if there's six months you've got access to that, what if you need it in a year?
sentences.zh: 就像你刚才说的那样，如果只有六个月的访问权限，如果你一年后需要它怎么办？

sentences.en: What if you haven't prepared enough for sort of finishing that training within the six months?
sentences.zh: 如果你没有为在六个月内完成培训做好充分准备怎么办？

sentences.en: And, you know, it just seems like they shoot themselves in the foot when they're trying to increase this inclusivity.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，当他们试图提高这种包容性时，这似乎是在搬起石头砸自己的脚。

sentences.en: They're trying to increase awareness to the role and bring more specific understanding from the wider industry into what psychologists do.
sentences.zh: 他们试图提高对该角色的认识，并从更广泛的行业中带来对心理学家所做工作的更具体理解。

sentences.en: It just seems a bit redundant at times.
sentences.zh: 这有时看起来有点多余。

sentences.en: But let's try and give them the benefit of the doubt with this document, I suppose.
sentences.zh: 但我想我们还是试着对这份文件给他们一些信任吧。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对的。

sentences.en: So, you know, this isn't supposed to be an anti-BPS thing.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，这并不是要反 BPS。

sentences.en: We're just, I guess we're just being curious and compassionately critical.
sentences.zh: 我想我们只是出于好奇，并进行富有同情心的批评。

sentences.en: And, you know, thinking about what we would think would be good enough, you know, in any in any circumstance, really, in the psychology profession.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，思考我们在任何情况下，在心理学专业中，认为什么是足够好的。

sentences.en: So for anyone who is just interested in our conversation or doesn't perhaps have access to BPS guidance.
sentences.zh: 所以对于那些只是对我们的对话感兴趣，或者可能无法访问 BPS 指南的人来说。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think overall, actually, from first read of it, I was quite pleasantly surprised.
sentences.zh: 是的，我觉得总的来说，从第一次阅读来看，我感到相当惊喜。

sentences.en: But I do think we can we can get into quite a few things here.
sentences.zh: 但我确实认为我们可以在这里讨论很多事情。

sentences.en: But I was pleasantly surprised with the depth of it.
sentences.zh: 但我对它的深度感到惊喜。

sentences.en: But I think it missed the point on a few sections, which I'm I'm sure you may agree with.
sentences.zh: 但我认为它在某些部分没有抓住重点，我相信你可能会同意。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: One of my one of my latter things that upset me was I was just getting into it.
sentences.zh: 我最后感到失望的事情之一是，我刚开始进入状态。

sentences.en: I mentioned it just for us to hit record, but I was just getting into it.
sentences.zh: 我在我们开始录音前提到过，但我刚开始进入状态。

sentences.en: And I was just at the point where I thought I'm quite enjoying this.
sentences.zh: 我正处于我觉得自己很享受这一点的阶段。

sentences.en: And I was like on page 24 or something of a 36 page document.
sentences.zh: 我当时在 36 页文档的第 24 页左右。

sentences.en: And then I flicked over the page and then it was references like it was it was done.
sentences.zh: 然后我翻过那一页，后面就是参考文献了，就像它结束了一样。

sentences.en: And I was like, oh, I feel like I needed or was expecting like a little bit more.
sentences.zh: 我当时想，噢，我觉得我需要或者期待更多一点内容。

sentences.en: Yeah, I know.
sentences.zh: 是的，我知道。

sentences.en: I was the exact same.
sentences.zh: 我和你完全一样。

sentences.en: And it actually really helped me this morning because I was blocking out like another hour or so to read it.
sentences.zh: 这今天早上确实对我很有帮助，因为我特意留出了大约一个小时左右的时间来阅读它。

sentences.en: But yeah, finished.
sentences.zh: 但是的，结束了。

sentences.en: So I was like, OK, I'm going to have to go and talk to some patients now, which is which is good.
sentences.zh: 所以我心想，好吧，我现在得去和一些病人谈谈了，这很好。

sentences.en: It's a positive.
sentences.zh: 这是一个积极的方面。

sentences.en: Exactly, though.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: But, you know, when you realise you've got a 36 page document to read, you give that the appropriate time that the document like that requires.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，当你意识到你有一份 36 页的文件要读时，你会给它分配像这样的文件所需要的适当时间。

sentences.en: And then obviously, actually, you've overread the pudding by about a third.
sentences.zh: 然后显然，实际上，你高估了它的篇幅大约三分之一。

sentences.en: But that said, you know, when I opened the document to begin with, I liked the glossary, you know, I liked terms being clear.
sentences.zh: 但话虽如此，你知道，当我刚打开文件时，我喜欢词汇表，你知道，我喜欢术语清晰。

sentences.en: And later on during the document, it describes what it wants assistant psychologists to be called and what it would prefer that they weren't.
sentences.zh: 在文件的后面，它描述了它希望助理心理学家被称为的称呼，以及它更希望他们不被称呼的称呼。

sentences.en: And actually, it makes things less ambiguous.
sentences.zh: 实际上，这让事情变得不那么模棱两可了。

sentences.en: I think it makes things a bit clearer.
sentences.zh: 我认为这让事情变得更清晰了一些。

sentences.en: So basically, they'd like them to be called assistant psychologist, assistant educational psychologist and voluntary assistant psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上，他们希望他们被称为助理心理学家、助理教育心理学家和志愿助理心理学家。

sentences.en: And really, those are the only three terms that they would they would like to be seen being discussed.
sentences.zh: 实际上，这三个术语是他们希望看到的讨论内容。

sentences.en: And I think that's really helpful because, you know, I mean, I spend a lot of time on LinkedIn.
sentences.zh: 我认为这真的很有帮助，因为，你知道，我的意思是，我花了很多时间在 LinkedIn 上。

sentences.en: Then variety of different job roles that I see people having.
sentences.zh: 我看到人们担任各种不同的工作角色。

sentences.en: And sometimes I'm like, well, they sound more qualified than me.
sentences.zh: 有时我会想，嗯，他们听起来比我更有资格。

sentences.en: Like, why is that?
sentences.zh: 为什么会这样？

sentences.en: I've never heard of that.
sentences.zh: 我从来没听说过那个。

sentences.en: And then I look and see that they've actually done their psychology degree and that's it.
sentences.zh: 然后我看了看，发现他们实际上只是完成了心理学学位，仅此而已。

sentences.en: And it's like, right.
sentences.zh: 就像是，好吧。

sentences.en: And so sometimes I've actually spoken to people and said, you know, what is this job title and how did that come about?
sentences.zh: 所以有时我实际上和人们谈过，说，你知道，这个职位名称是什么，它是怎么来的？

sentences.en: And they're like, well, that's what our service asks us to call ourselves.
sentences.zh: 他们说，嗯，那是我们的服务机构要求我们这样称呼自己的。

sentences.en: And I sort of it feels a little bit it feels a little bit dodgy to me.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这对我来说有点，有点可疑。

sentences.en: And actually, it does make you sound very, very qualified.
sentences.zh: 实际上，这确实让你听起来非常有资格。

sentences.en: You know, it's like psychology lead or psych psychologist in charge or something like that.
sentences.zh: 你知道，就像心理学主管或负责心理学家之类的。

sentences.en: And I don't know, that sounds big.
sentences.zh: 我不知道，这听起来很大。

sentences.en: So, yeah, for me, just this might empower people already in what is essentially assistant psychologist role to start that conversation with their employers about actually,
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，对我来说，这可能会赋予那些本质上是助理心理学家角色的人权力，开始与他们的雇主进行对话，关于实际上，

sentences.en: could we look to rename me in line or rename this role?
sentences.zh: 我们能否考虑按照指南重新命名我，或者重新命名这个角色？

sentences.en: It's not just about person, is it?
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是关于个人的，对吧？

sentences.en: In line with the guidance from the British Psychological Society.
sentences.zh: 符合英国心理学会的指南。

sentences.en: Yeah, I totally agree.
sentences.zh: 是的，我完全同意。

sentences.en: I remember in the last episode we did, we spent quite a bit of time discussing the sort of common ambiguity of the role for various reasons.
sentences.zh: 我记得在我们做的上一集中，我们花了很多时间讨论由于各种原因导致的角色模糊性。

sentences.en: And I do I totally agree that it's helpful.
sentences.zh: 我完全同意这很有帮助。

sentences.en: The BPS have kind of said there's there's three pathways in which we would accept govern and assistant psych.
sentences.zh: BPS 已经表示，有三种途径是我们愿意接受和管理助理心理学家的。

sentences.en: And with regards to the voluntary, which I'm sure we'll get into a little bit because we spoke about it last time, the voluntary role, they do say that we don't support that.
sentences.zh: 关于志愿角色，我相信我们会深入讨论，因为我们上次谈到了它，志愿角色，他们确实说我们不支持它。

sentences.en: However, however, we acknowledge it exists.
sentences.zh: 然而，然而，我们承认它的存在。

sentences.en: So this is our recommendation.
sentences.zh: 所以这是我们的建议。

sentences.en: So I think it's really, really helpful to see them sort of clamping down and being more specific for those reasons you've just stated.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为看到他们因为你刚才陈述的原因而进行打击并变得更加具体，真的非常有帮助。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对的。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think the honorary role is a big conversation.
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为荣誉角色是一个很大的话题。

sentences.en: And we will come back to it, I'm sure.
sentences.zh: 我相信我们会回到这个话题的。

sentences.en: So I think for me, it also.
sentences.zh: 所以我想对我来说，它也。

sentences.en: They said that to be an assistant psychologist, you need to be a psychology graduate, which obviously then gives you the graduate basis for registration.
sentences.zh: 他们说要成为助理心理学家，你需要是心理学专业的毕业生，这显然能为你提供注册所需的毕业生基础。

sentences.en: I get it wrong.
sentences.zh: 我弄错了。

sentences.en: Is it GVC or GBR?
sentences.zh: 是 GVC 还是 GBR？

sentences.en: I think I had GBR and we're talking about GVC now, are we?
sentences.zh: 我想我之前有 GBR，但我们现在是在讨论 GVC，对吧？

sentences.en: No, I've got like, I get them mixed up.
sentences.zh: 不，我有点把它们搞混了。

sentences.en: They used to be something different.
sentences.zh: 它们以前是不同的东西。

sentences.en: So what is it and what was it?
sentences.zh: 那它现在是什么，以前又是什么？

sentences.en: I think it's GVC, but I'm just checking my LinkedIn because I have GVC.
sentences.zh: 我想是 GVC，但我正在查我的领英，因为我有 GVC。

sentences.en: That's graduate basis for chartership though, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 但那是特许资格的毕业生基础，对吧？

sentences.en: So I have GMBPSS, which on the document, because I remember being really confused when the doctor application was asking for my titles.
sentences.zh: 所以我拥有 GMBPSS，在文件上是这样写的，因为我记得在申请医生职位时，被问到我的头衔，我当时真的很困惑。

sentences.en: I was really confused.
sentences.zh: 我当时真的很困惑。

sentences.en: Have I got graduate basis for chartership?
sentences.zh: 我有特许资格的毕业生基础吗？

sentences.en: And apparently you do, which gives you the GMBPS.
sentences.zh: 显然你有，这给了你 GMBPS。

sentences.en: But when you are at the level where you have passed through traineeship, that's when you can use GVC.
sentences.zh: 但当你达到通过实习的阶段时，你就可以使用 GVC 了。

sentences.en: And then after trainee, you're qualified.
sentences.zh: 实习结束后，你就具备了正式资格。

sentences.en: So, yeah, for me, it's clarifying what an assistant psychologist is and that an assistant psychologist must be a graduate, which then made me think, well,
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，对我来说，这澄清了什么是助理心理学家，而且助理心理学家必须是毕业生，这让我不禁想到，嗯，

sentences.en: why are people advertising placement years as assistant psychologist posts?
sentences.zh: 为什么人们会把实习年职位宣传为助理心理学家岗位？

sentences.en: Because they ought not to be, because actually that is against the BPS guidance now.
sentences.zh: 因为他们不应该这样做，因为这实际上违反了英国心理学会（BPS）现在的指导意见。

sentences.en: Yeah, like who's leading, who is it?
sentences.zh: 是啊，到底是谁在领导，是谁在负责？

sentences.en: The BPS is supposed to be guiding the industry.
sentences.zh: BPS 本应是行业指导机构。

sentences.en: And I had a quick, really quick look at some of the job applications for assistant psychologists after reading this document.
sentences.zh: 在读完这份文件后，我快速浏览了一些助理心理学家的求职申请。

sentences.en: And whilst they're improving, there's still a few things that are not what the BPS have advised in this.
sentences.zh: 虽然情况有所改善，但仍有一些地方不符合 BPS 在此文件中的建议。

sentences.en: So it just begs the question, who is supposed to be governing whom?
sentences.zh: 这不禁让人质疑，到底谁该监管谁？

sentences.en: And I don't know where this confusion is coming from, but it would be nice to see everything sort of in the one path, like this document and students, they're not assistants,
sentences.zh: 我不知道这种困惑从何而来，但如果一切都能在同一个轨道上运行会很好，比如这份文件和学生们，他们不是助理，

sentences.en: like you say.
sentences.zh: 就像你说的。

sentences.en: It would be dangerous kind of for them, as well as the service to be given that responsibility when they're just at university,
sentences.zh: 对于他们以及服务机构来说，在他们还只是大学生时就被赋予这种责任是很危险的，

sentences.en: because there's a big difference in skill level and competencies and just personal development at that point.
sentences.zh: 因为在那个阶段，技能水平、能力和个人发展方面存在巨大差异。

sentences.en: Yeah, and I think for me, one of the things that shone out of this guidance was this should be a development role.
sentences.zh: 是的，对我来说，这份指南中让我眼前一亮的一点是，这应该是一个发展性的角色。

sentences.en: And even in cases where this is a voluntary role, I almost called it honorary, but I'm going to call it voluntary from now on.
sentences.zh: 即使在这是志愿角色的情况下——我差点称之为“荣誉”职位，但我以后还是称它为“志愿”职位吧。

sentences.en: Because I think honorary makes the company feel better about it and perhaps makes the person feel better as well.
sentences.zh: 因为我觉得“荣誉”会让公司感觉好受些，或许也会让当事人感觉好受些。

sentences.en: But it is a voluntary role and it said that it should be no more than basically one day a week volunteering, whole time equivalent,
sentences.zh: 但它确实是一个志愿角色，文件中说它基本上不应超过每周一天的志愿服务，按全职等效计算，

sentences.en: and that there should still be the same amount of requirements for supervision.
sentences.zh: 而且对督导的要求应该保持不变。

sentences.en: And that there should still be kind of job plans and progression happening as part of that role.
sentences.zh: 并且作为该角色的一部分，仍然应该有工作计划和职业发展。

sentences.en: And, you know, you still have a right to accrue toil, obviously not paid time off, but if you're doing over and above the time that the service have said they want you for,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，你仍然有权积累加班时间，当然不是带薪休假，但如果你做的工作超出了服务机构要求的时间，

sentences.en: you can take that time back and that you still have rights to unpaid annual leave.
sentences.zh: 你可以把时间补回来，而且你仍然有权享受无薪年假。

sentences.en: And, yeah, for me, that really made me think about when I've been in services where there have been voluntary members of staff, that sometimes it might just be like, oh, oh,
sentences.zh: 是的，对我来说，这真的让我想起我曾经待过的服务机构，那里有志愿工作人员，有时可能只是，哦，哦，

sentences.en: so-and-so is not here tomorrow because they're on annual leave.
sentences.zh: 某某明天不在，因为他们在休年假。

sentences.en: Perhaps we could ask the honoree to come in, whereas in actual fact that's not OK.
sentences.zh: 也许我们可以叫那个志愿者来帮忙，而实际上这是不行的。

sentences.en: You know, it probably never was, well, it never was, but this firms that up more.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这可能从来都不行，嗯，确实从来都不行，但这份文件对此做了更明确的规定。

sentences.en: This isn't just a supernumerary member of staff like you might have on an NHS ward to meet minimum numbers.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是一个像你在国民医疗服务体系（NHS）病房里为了凑够最低人数而安排的额外人员。

sentences.en: This is a voluntary member of staff who cannot be counted in the numbers.
sentences.zh: 这是一个不能计入编制的志愿工作人员。

sentences.en: And actually there was even questions raised about whether,
sentences.zh: 事实上，甚至有人提出疑问，

sentences.en: whether a voluntary member of staff is definitely covered on the organisation's indemnity and that that needs to be an explicit conversation.
sentences.zh: 志愿工作人员是否确实在机构的赔偿保险范围内，这需要进行明确的沟通。

sentences.en: Whereas in my experience, this is just not the case.
sentences.zh: 而在我的经验中，事实并非如此。

sentences.en: And a voluntary member of staff has just been exploited massively, basically, in a nutshell.
sentences.zh: 简而言之，志愿工作人员基本上受到了严重的剥削。

sentences.en: So, yeah, totally.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，完全同意。

sentences.en: I mean, I haven't been around the honorary role, but it just screams exploitation, because even if all those things were put in place, like, well,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我没有接触过“荣誉”职位，但这听起来就是剥削，因为即使所有这些条件都落实了，嗯，

sentences.en: I say that I can't see how supervision or access to supervision would happen with a seven hour shift.
sentences.zh: 我说过，我看不出七小时的轮班如何能实现督导或获得督导的机会。

sentences.en: I think it was seven hours or seven and a half.
sentences.zh: 我想是七小时或七个半小时。

sentences.en: I don't see access to that purely because of the pressures on teams and services.
sentences.zh: 我看不出他们能获得这种机会，纯粹是因为团队和服务机构面临的压力。

sentences.en: I don't see them not being given extra responsibilities that they shouldn't be doing, because, as you know, you've worked in the NHS and you're still close to it.
sentences.zh: 我看不出他们不会被分配不该做的额外责任，因为如你所知，你在 NHS 工作过，而且你现在仍然与之保持密切联系。

sentences.en: The pressures are the pressures.
sentences.zh: 压力就是压力。

sentences.en: And unfortunately, often everyone has to get lumped with things they shouldn't necessarily be doing, which is what we were discussing last time,
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，通常每个人都不得不承担他们不一定该做的事情，这就是我们上次讨论的内容，

sentences.en: which is why we wanted the extra guidance, which I think this is helpful for.
sentences.zh: 这也是我们想要额外指导的原因，我认为这份文件对此很有帮助。

sentences.en: But I still just don't understand why the honorary role exists, because it's exploitative, but it also cuts off a lot of the potential workforce that couldn't get into psychology.
sentences.zh: 但我仍然不明白为什么“荣誉”职位会存在，因为它不仅具有剥削性，还切断了许多无法进入心理学领域的潜在劳动力。

sentences.en: Like myself, I'm a white male, so statistically, I'm of a privileged position.
sentences.zh: 就像我自己，我是白人男性，所以从统计学上讲，我处于特权地位。

sentences.en: I couldn't do that.
sentences.zh: 我做不到那样。

sentences.en: I couldn't work for free for a day, so it must be cutting off a lot of people, so I don't see why the need exists still.
sentences.zh: 我无法免费工作一天，所以这肯定切断了许多人的路，所以我看不出为什么这种需求仍然存在。

sentences.en: And maybe you know more about that from, like, a managerial service development point of view, NHS, why it would still continue existing.
sentences.zh: 也许你从管理和服务发展的角度，从 NHS 的角度，更了解为什么它会继续存在。

sentences.en: I don't know if you could speak upon that with the pressures as to why the role may exist still.
sentences.zh: 我不知道在面临这些压力的情况下，你是否能谈谈为什么这个角色可能仍然存在。

sentences.en: I think it's because it's condoned, because it's been established as a viable way of plugging service gaps, and there hasn't been enough of a stand against it.
sentences.zh: 我认为是因为它被默许了，因为它已被确立为填补服务缺口的可行方式，而且没有足够的反对声音。

sentences.en: And actually, if I was still working in the NHS, I think I would be part of that stand.
sentences.zh: 事实上，如果我还在 NHS 工作，我想我会参与到反对的行列中。

sentences.en: I cannot ethically get behind asking people to work for free.
sentences.zh: 在道德上，我无法支持要求人们免费工作。

sentences.en: I can't hold interviews for who gets the privilege of coming to work with me for free and paying, you know, for their parking and their commuting costs and, you know,
sentences.zh: 我无法主持面试，去决定谁有幸能免费为我工作，还要自己支付停车费、通勤费，你知道，

sentences.en: their lunch money and all of that.
sentences.zh: 还有午餐费等等。

sentences.en: So actually, they're out of pocket.
sentences.zh: 所以实际上，他们是在自掏腰包。

sentences.en: So I think, hopefully, this guidance and the ACP guidance before it starts to, and this podcast maybe do, starts to turn the tide on that a little bit.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，希望这份指南以及之前的 ACP 指南，还有这个播客，能开始稍微扭转这种局面。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊，是啊。

sentences.en: It's good to see that they made several references throughout the document that the BPS doesn't agree with this role existing, but given it exists and the pressures it exists,
sentences.zh: 很高兴看到他们在文件中多次提到 BPS 不同意这个角色的存在，但考虑到它确实存在及其背后的压力，

sentences.en: we strongly recommend X, Y, Z.
sentences.zh: 我们强烈建议采取 X、Y、Z 措施。

sentences.en: So maybe that, as you say, is a start in the right direction.
sentences.zh: 所以也许正如你所说，这是朝着正确方向迈出的一步。

sentences.en: And hopefully, that gives people the platform to talk more about it, such as this podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 希望这能为人们提供一个讨论此事的平台，比如这个播客。

sentences.en: And hopefully, one day, pretty soon, we can get rid of it, because I just, I don't see the positives in it, really.
sentences.zh: 希望有一天，很快，我们能彻底废除它，因为我真的看不出它有什么积极意义。

sentences.en: And I think especially because there's lots of mentions across the guidance around equality, diversity and inclusion and trying to kind of think about contextual factors, you know,
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，特别是因为指南中多次提到平等、多样性和包容性，并试图考虑背景因素，你知道，

sentences.en: they are recognising just how inaccessible the profession can be.
sentences.zh: 他们认识到这个行业是多么难以进入。

sentences.en: And so to add that further tier of voluntary roles, you know, I was reading it thinking, if I've done a voluntary placement year,
sentences.zh: 因此，增加志愿角色这一层级，你知道，我读的时候就在想，如果我做了一年的志愿实习，

sentences.en: and I'm legally allowed to say that that was an assistant psychologist post, and put that I've worked for nine months, whole time equivalent, as an assistant psychologist,
sentences.zh: 而且我合法地可以说那是助理心理学家的岗位，并写上我做了九个月的全职等效助理心理学家工作，

sentences.en: I'm going to have a significant advantage in gaining interviews for paid assistant roles.
sentences.zh: 我在获得带薪助理职位面试时将具有显著优势。

sentences.en: Yeah, just, I think if you're not allowed to do that, then you'd have to call yourself a psychology worker, or just a placement student, like,
sentences.zh: 是的，只是，我想如果你不被允许这样做，你就得称自己为心理学工作者，或者只是实习生，就像，

sentences.en: what would you call yourself in those circumstances?
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下你会怎么称呼自己？

sentences.en: Because in my experience, everybody tends to call themselves an assistant psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 因为在我的经验中，每个人往往都称自己为助理心理学家。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah, yeah, you're right.
sentences.zh: 是啊，是啊，是啊，你说得对。

sentences.en: I've come across psychology assistants in, I suppose that was more private healthcare.
sentences.zh: 我遇到过心理学助理，我想那更多是在私立医疗机构。

sentences.en: And they, they appeared sort of, like half the role of an assistant psychologist, but that was used interchangeably over there.
sentences.zh: 他们看起来像是承担了助理心理学家一半的角色，但在那里这些称呼是可以互换的。

sentences.en: So I honestly don't know what you could be referred to as.
sentences.zh: 所以我真的不知道你会被称为什么。

sentences.en: And as you said, honorary makes it honorary is like a more positive spin.
sentences.zh: 正如你所说，“荣誉”职位听起来是一种更积极的说法。

sentences.en: It's not, it's not an honorary position, is it is an honorary position is usually used for like quite senior people with maybe in academic institutions.
sentences.zh: 它不是，它不是一个荣誉职位，对吧？荣誉职位通常用于学术机构中资历很高的人。

sentences.en: This definitely isn't that it feels and seems like exploitative, potentially grunt work where they shouldn't be doing that at all.
sentences.zh: 这绝对不是那样，它感觉起来像是剥削，可能是做一些他们根本不该做的杂活。

sentences.en: Yeah, and regardless of whether someone is voluntary or paid, you know, they should be assisting with it,
sentences.zh: 是的，无论一个人是志愿者还是带薪员工，你知道，他们都应该协助，

sentences.en: with the work of at least one practitioner psychologiSt. And I think sometimes that is just not the case, is it?
sentences.zh: 至少协助一位执业心理学家的工作。我想有时情况并非如此，对吧？

sentences.en: Sometimes these posts, as we spoke about last time, are advertised and the practitioner psychologist doesn't even work in the service that supervises them.
sentences.zh: 有时这些岗位，正如我们上次谈到的，在招聘时，督导他们的执业心理学家甚至不在该服务机构工作。

sentences.en: It's kind of super remote.
sentences.zh: 这有点太远程了。

sentences.en: They might even only have one contact hour a week.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至可能每周只有一个小时的联系时间。

sentences.en: And that is not, that is not a safe service.
sentences.zh: 那不是，那不是一个安全的服务。

sentences.en: And that is not an assistant psychologist role, as this guidance understands it.
sentences.zh: 那也不是本指南所理解的助理心理学家角色。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah, totally.
sentences.zh: 是啊，是啊，完全同意。

sentences.en: I don't know how you could achieve those things in one day.
sentences.zh: 我不知道你怎么能在一天之内完成那些事情。

sentences.en: And just as you were saying that I was just having a quick look back over the guidance, and I've come to the job descriptions and person specifications.
sentences.zh: 就在你说的时候，我快速浏览了一下指南，我看到了职位描述和人员规范部分。

sentences.en: And if you don't mind, I'll just, I'll just read out the paragraph I highlighted.
sentences.zh: 如果你不介意，我读一下我高亮的那一段。

sentences.en: AP duties should broadly align with those held by a practitioner psychologist, like you mentioned, but they should be at a level proportionate to the nature of the role,
sentences.zh: 助理心理学家的职责应大致与执业心理学家的职责保持一致，正如你提到的，但应与角色的性质相称，

sentences.en: should exclude management responsibilities, and should include increased supervision.
sentences.zh: 应排除管理职责，并应包括更多的督导。

sentences.en: So right there, that is at odds with the honorary.
sentences.zh: 所以就在这里，这与“荣誉”职位是相矛盾的。

sentences.en: And at least anecdotally, with people I know who've worked in assistant roles, they haven't achieved that.
sentences.zh: 至少从我认识的做过助理工作的人的轶事来看，他们并没有达到这一点。

sentences.en: They should not be asked to take on roles that are significantly distinct from typical practitioner psychologist roles that rotates with or are combined with non-psychologist responsibilities,
sentences.zh: 他们不应被要求承担与典型执业心理学家角色明显不同的职责，这些职责与非心理学职责轮换或结合，

sentences.en: e.g. healthcare assistant roles, which we've kind of just alluded to, that could happen.
sentences.zh: 例如医疗助理角色，我们刚才提到过，这种情况可能会发生。

sentences.en: Or are primarily administrative.
sentences.zh: 或者主要是行政工作。

sentences.en: And then it goes on to recommend physical restraint is not part of the AP job role, which may be a separate conversation, but I think is really helpful to see that there.
sentences.zh: 接着它建议身体约束不属于助理心理学家的工作职责，这可能是另一个话题，但我认为看到这一点非常有帮助。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: I'd considered that paragraph as well.
sentences.zh: 我也考虑过那一段。

sentences.en: And I don't know, for me, if you're working in an inpatient secure facility, restraint is potentially everybody's role.
sentences.zh: 我不知道，对我来说，如果你在住院安全设施中工作，约束可能就是每个人的职责。

sentences.en: You know, you know, it's tricky.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你知道，这很棘手。

sentences.en: I think if there's a core staff of nursing staff available to do it, then that makes most appropriate sense.
sentences.zh: 我认为如果有核心护理人员可以做这件事，那是最合适的。

sentences.en: But if you are there and there is severe harm happening to somebody, you can't really say, I'm not doing that because I'm an assistant psychologist, can you?
sentences.zh: 但如果你在那里，有人正受到严重伤害，你不能真的说“我不会那样做，因为我是助理心理学家”，对吧？

sentences.en: No, I think you're right.
sentences.zh: 不，我想你是对的。

sentences.en: Having worked in acute settings, and I'm sure you have yourself been around them, you would definitely hope there is a reasonably well-staffed clinical team there.
sentences.zh: 在急性病房工作过，我相信你自己也接触过，你肯定希望那里有一个配备合理的临床团队。

sentences.en: And I suppose it was helpful for me when I came into my current setting, which is adult rehab services.
sentences.zh: 我想当我进入目前的成人康复服务机构时，这对我很有帮助。

sentences.en: I had similar questions about that, because the environment is similar to an acute ward.
sentences.zh: 我对此也有类似的问题，因为环境与急性病房相似。

sentences.en: It's not the same high security, but it's similar in nature.
sentences.zh: 虽然不是同样的高安全性，但性质相似。

sentences.en: And it kind of made me think of my time on acute wards when I was a healthcare assistant, and we would be responding.
sentences.zh: 这让我想起我做医疗助理时在急性病房的时光，我们当时会做出反应。

sentences.en: And the advice was sort of the therapy team, which psychology is included under, shouldn't be responding because it severs that therapeutic relationship,
sentences.zh: 当时的建议是治疗团队（包括心理学）不应该参与反应，因为它会破坏治疗关系，

sentences.en: or potentially severs, which until that moment, I hadn't really thought of that.
sentences.zh: 或者可能破坏，在那一刻之前，我真的没想过这一点。

sentences.en: And I thought that was a great piece of advice, because we are seen as a bit differently, and it's supposed to kind of add to the assistant psychologist role.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一个很好的建议，因为我们被看待的方式有点不同，这应该能增加助理心理学家的角色价值。

sentences.en: We are seen as an extra part of the clinical team, but also a little bit different depending on the population we're working with.
sentences.zh: 我们被视为临床团队的额外部分，但也根据我们服务的群体而略有不同。

sentences.en: We can get a bit closer to them.
sentences.zh: 我们可以与他们走得更近一点。

sentences.en: We have the extra knowledge of the degree, but we also have, hopefully, supervision from a professional or clinical qualified.
sentences.zh: 我们拥有学位的额外知识，但我们也希望有来自专业或临床合格人员的督导。

sentences.en: And we don't want to damage that therapeutic relationship.
sentences.zh: 我们不想破坏那种治疗关系。

sentences.en: However, to your point, if there was absolutely no one else around, yes, I would be expected to help out, and we should.
sentences.zh: 然而，回到你的观点，如果周围绝对没有其他人，是的，我会被期望去帮忙，我们也应该帮忙。

sentences.en: So maybe there could be an asterisk on the document, alluding to what we're talking about, sort of emergency situations.
sentences.zh: 所以也许可以在文件上加个星号，提到我们正在讨论的紧急情况。

sentences.en: Maybe they should be trained in it, and guidance should be sort of, let the clinical team respond, nursing team, absolute necessary, must, risk to self, risk to others.
sentences.zh: 也许他们应该接受相关培训，指导意见应该是，让临床团队、护理团队去应对，绝对必要时，必须应对，为了自身风险，为了他人风险。

sentences.en: Because I totally agree with your point there.
sentences.zh: 因为我完全同意你的观点。

sentences.en: Yeah, lovely.
sentences.zh: 是啊，很好。

sentences.en: One bit that made me quite interested, both from a qualified perspective as well as an unqualified perspective, was when they were talking about the fixed-term roles,
sentences.zh: 有一点让我很感兴趣，无论是从合格人员的角度还是未合格人员的角度，那就是当他们谈到固定期限角色时，

sentences.en: and that ideally, they ought to be for a minimum of 12 months.
sentences.zh: 理想情况下，它们应该至少为期 12 个月。

sentences.en: And I was thinking, oh, I've done six-month roles.
sentences.zh: 我在想，哦，我做过六个月的角色。

sentences.en: I've done nine-month roles.
sentences.zh: 我做过九个月的角色。

sentences.en: So 12 months obviously would be great, but there also ought to be a minimum three-month notice of renewals or not renewals.
sentences.zh: 所以 12 个月显然很好，但续约或不续约也应该提前至少三个月通知。

sentences.en: And that made me think, oh, gosh, sometimes I've been like a week away and got the nod that I'm being kept on.
sentences.zh: 这让我想起，哦，天哪，有时我离合同结束只有一周了才得到留任的消息。

sentences.en: So something that makes that a little bit firmer, but also I think empowers people to be able to think, oh, mine is four months away.
sentences.zh: 所以如果能让这一点更明确一些会更好，而且我认为这也能赋予人们力量去想，哦，我的合同还有四个月到期。

sentences.en: I'll take this to supervision.
sentences.zh: 我会把这个带到督导中去讨论。

sentences.en: I'll take this to my management to discuss this, because wheels do turn very slowly in organisations.
sentences.zh: 我会和管理层讨论这个问题，因为机构里的事情进展确实非常缓慢。

sentences.en: But, you know, it now gives you that kind of clout behind you to say, or does it?
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，这现在给了你某种支持，让你去说，或者真的有吗？

sentences.en: Because would you feel comfortable with saying, I am aware.
sentences.zh: 因为你会觉得说出来很自在吗？“我知道”。

sentences.en: We're four months away from the end of my contract, and the BPS guidance does say that we ought to be aware three months in advance.
sentences.zh: 我的合同还有四个月就到期了，BPS 指南确实说我们应该提前三个月知道。

sentences.en: Or, you know, there is that power differential, isn't there?
sentences.zh: 或者，你知道，存在那种权力差异，不是吗？

sentences.en: How would you feel about that if you were on a fixed-term contract, Luke?
sentences.zh: 如果你签的是固定期限合同，你会怎么看，Luke？

sentences.en: Oh, I've been on a fixed-term contract like yourself, and I totally agree with you.
sentences.zh: 哦，我和你一样签过固定期限合同，我完全同意你的看法。

sentences.en: It was very nice to see that, very pleasant to see it.
sentences.zh: 看到这一点真的很好，非常令人欣慰。

sentences.en: But also I chuckled a little bit like, oof, wow, big, big step, because I've been on fixed terMs.
sentences.zh: 但我也轻笑了一下，心想，喔，哇，很大的一步，因为我签过固定期限合同。

sentences.en: I'm now luckily on a permanent, which is really nice.
sentences.zh: 我现在很幸运地签了长期合同，这真的很好。

sentences.en: But with regards to the example you're giving, approaching your manager, whoever is in control of these things, line manager,
sentences.zh: 但关于你举的例子，接近你的经理，或者任何负责这些事情的人，直线经理，

sentences.en: hey, contract's running out in so many months.
sentences.zh: 嘿，合同还有几个月就到期了。

sentences.en: Can we discuss X, Y, Z?
sentences.zh: 我们能讨论一下X、Y、Z吗？

sentences.en: And I've had those conversations.
sentences.zh: 而且我也进行过那些对话。

sentences.en: It's like, yeah, yeah, yeah, we'll get back to it.
sentences.zh: 感觉就像是，嗯嗯嗯，我们会回头再处理的。

sentences.en: Things will be okay.
sentences.zh: 一切都会好起来的。

sentences.en: Time creeps on.
sentences.zh: 时间在悄悄流逝。

sentences.en: You have the conversation again.
sentences.zh: 你又进行了那次对话。

sentences.en: Yeah, things are going well.
sentences.zh: 嗯，事情进展顺利。

sentences.en: And then I know similar people have had similar experiences to me, and some of them have actually told me they've gone back to their supervisors who said,
sentences.zh: 而且我知道有类似经历的人也和我一样，他们中有些人甚至告诉我，他们回去找主管，主管说，

sentences.en: yes, we're going to extend.
sentences.zh: 好的，我们要续约。

sentences.en: And then they were told, no, we're not going to extend.
sentences.zh: 然后他们又被告知，不，我们不打算续约。

sentences.en: And it's like, okay, I've got a month to find a job, if that, which, as you know yourself, and as everyone listening will probably know,
sentences.zh: 这就像是，好吧，我只有一个多月的时间去找工作，如果这算时间的话，而且正如你自己所知，也正如每一位听众可能都知道的那样，

sentences.en: things move quite slowly with the job applications and getting through references and such.
sentences.zh: 求职、通过背景调查之类的流程进展相当缓慢。

sentences.en: So I think it'd be really helpful to be able to take this to whoever's in charge and say, look, I know you're busy.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，如果能把这个问题带给负责人并说，看，我知道你很忙，那会非常有帮助。

sentences.en: I know things are up in the air.
sentences.zh: 我知道事情还没定下来。

sentences.en: We have to have awareness.
sentences.zh: 我们必须有这种意识。

sentences.en: We have to have knowledge noticed three months before.
sentences.zh: 我们必须提前三个月知晓。

sentences.en: So really, really good to see.
sentences.zh: 所以这真的非常非常值得一看。

sentences.en: Yeah, because, you know, this is rent.
sentences.zh: 是的，因为，你知道，这关系到房租。

sentences.en: This is mortgage.
sentences.zh: 这关系到抵押贷款。

sentences.en: This is childcare.
sentences.zh: 这关系到托儿费。

sentences.en: This is, you know, supermarket bills.
sentences.zh: 这关系到，你知道，超市账单。

sentences.en: This is being able to pay your car bills.
sentences.zh: 这关系到能否支付你的汽车账单。

sentences.en: Like, this is, these are people's lives, you know.
sentences.zh: 就像是，这些都是人们的生活，你知道吗。

sentences.en: And I think once you get qualified and perhaps get a little bit further removed from the kind of aspiring psychologist angle,
sentences.zh: 我认为一旦你获得了资格，或许离那种有抱负的心理学家的视角稍微远了一点，

sentences.en: it's easier to forget that, I think.
sentences.zh: 我想，就更容易忘记这一点了。

sentences.en: Yeah, that makes total sense.
sentences.zh: 是的，这完全说得通。

sentences.en: And that's what we're all after, I suppose.
sentences.zh: 我想这正是我们都在追求的。

sentences.en: But that kind of goes hand in hand with having to put up with this in the first few years.
sentences.zh: 但这与在最初几年不得不忍受这些情况是相辅相成的。

sentences.en: And certain things we have to put up with that are probably just like outdated habits, which, and behaviours, which we could easily do away with.
sentences.zh: 而且我们不得不忍受的某些事情可能只是过时的习惯和行为，我们本可以轻易摒弃的。

sentences.en: So it's good to see this.
sentences.zh: 所以看到这个（指南）很好。

sentences.en: Yeah, it really is.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And it really made me think about when I've done supervision for people,
sentences.zh: 这真的让我思考起我为他人做督导的时候，

sentences.en: because I actually have always thought that I needed to kind of countersign everybody's notes because they didn't yet have clinical responsibility.
sentences.zh: 因为我实际上一直认为我需要对每个人的记录进行会签，因为他们还没有临床责任。

sentences.en: But this guidance really suggests that so long as the general standard of notes is being adhered to, that's no longer necessarily enforceable.
sentences.zh: 但这份指南确实建议，只要记录符合一般标准，就不再一定强制要求会签了。

sentences.en: Obviously, someone was concerned about the standard of notes.
sentences.zh: 显然，如果有人担心记录的标准，

sentences.en: They may still choose to do that.
sentences.zh: 他们可能仍然会选择这样做。

sentences.en: And you might get someone who is a bit of a control freak asking for that to happen.
sentences.zh: 而且你可能会遇到一个有点控制欲强的人要求这样做。

sentences.en: But actually, it might be useful to, you know, because of the pressures of services, you know, even to write my own clinical notes.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，这可能很有用，你知道，因为服务压力，你知道，甚至连我自己写临床记录也是如此。

sentences.en: I've seen three clients today.
sentences.zh: 我今天看了三个客户。

sentences.en: I haven't yet written them.
sentences.zh: 我还没写记录。

sentences.en: I've got to write them today.
sentences.zh: 我今天得把它们写完。

sentences.en: So after we meet.
sentences.zh: 就在我们见面之后。

sentences.en: So in terms of the pressures of doing our own clinical notes, let alone checking, you know, perhaps your entire caseload of notes before I finish for the week,
sentences.zh: 所以，就我们自己写临床记录的压力而言，更不用说在我这周结束前检查你可能整个病例的记录了，

sentences.en: it does just make it that much trickier to do.
sentences.zh: 这确实让事情变得棘手多了。

sentences.en: So this might be an interesting conversation in supervision, but this is no longer necessarily a requirement.
sentences.zh: 所以这在督导中可能是一个有趣的对话，但这不再一定是一项要求了。

sentences.en: And how do we want to take that forward?
sentences.zh: 我们想如何推进这件事呢？

sentences.en: What do we want to do about that?
sentences.zh: 我们想怎么处理这件事？

sentences.en: Do we want to explore making changes to the way that we do things in our service currently?
sentences.zh: 我们想探索改变我们目前服务中的做事方式吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I was really surprised with that because like you, I was under the impression everything had to be countersigned by qualified.
sentences.zh: 是的，我对此感到非常惊讶，因为和你一样，我一直以为所有东西都必须由有资格的人会签。

sentences.en: And if you were, for example, my supervisor, I assume that would free up a lot of time or you countersigning things would take a lot of time.
sentences.zh: 而且如果你是我的主管，我想这会腾出很多时间，或者你进行会签会占用很多时间。

sentences.en: But I get it.
sentences.zh: 但我明白了。

sentences.en: It's best practice.
sentences.zh: 这是最佳实践。

sentences.en: It would be reflecting on you as the supervisor should something go wrong.
sentences.zh: 如果出了什么问题，这会反映在你这位主管身上。

sentences.en: But as you say, after a while, we could we could discuss this in supervision.
sentences.zh: 但正如你所说，过了一段时间，我们可以在督导中讨论这个问题。

sentences.en: And if they are up to a certain standard and it's like 85, 90 percent of the time that standard's being hit.
sentences.zh: 如果它们达到了某种标准，而且有85%到90%的时间都达到了那个标准。

sentences.en: Yeah, it gives them a bit more responsibility, gives us a bit more responsibility and frees up that time that qualified from what from what I can see just don't seem to have.
sentences.zh: 是的，这给了他们更多的责任，也给了我们更多的责任，并腾出了那些有资格的人看起来似乎根本没有的时间。

sentences.en: You guys don't seem to have a lot of time to be spread out everywhere.
sentences.zh: 你们似乎没有太多时间到处分身。

sentences.en: So we've got too many projects, too many plates spinning, but too many demands upon our time generally, you know, and that is absolutely the case,
sentences.zh: 所以我们有太多的项目，太多的事情要同时处理，但总的来说，对我们时间的需求太多了，你知道，这绝对是事实，

sentences.en: whether you are in private practice or it will be NHS.
sentences.zh: 无论你是在私人诊所还是在国民医疗服务体系（NHS）。

sentences.en: And of course, the NHS can have its own additional pressures.
sentences.zh: 当然，NHS本身也会有额外的压力。

sentences.en: I really liked the section about how supervision should be used, how supervision could be used.
sentences.zh: 我真的很喜欢关于应该如何使用督导、督导可以如何使用的那一节。

sentences.en: I thought that was quite nice to have written down.
sentences.zh: 我觉得能把它写下来真是太好了。

sentences.en: Yeah, definitely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对是。

sentences.en: In my personal experience, I have struggled with supervision in times over my various roles, sometimes coming in with it being sort of a bit cloudy, a bit ambiguous,
sentences.zh: 以我个人的经验，我在担任各种职务期间，有时会为督导感到挣扎，有时带着一种模糊不清、模棱两可的感觉去参加，

sentences.en: not really knowing what it's specifically used for.
sentences.zh: 并不真正知道它具体是用来做什么的。

sentences.en: And then other positions, it's been very specifically defined,
sentences.zh: 而在其他职位上，它被定义得非常明确，

sentences.en: and I felt like I couldn't bring certain things into that space because they didn't meet the predetermined definition of what supervision was for.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我无法把某些事情带入那个空间，因为它们不符合督导预定的定义。

sentences.en: So it's really good to see this, and they went into quite detail, actually, quite a bit of detail.
sentences.zh: 所以能看到这个指南真的很好，而且他们实际上写得相当详细，相当深入。

sentences.en: So it's really good to see that it can be sort of what you and your supervisor create, and with time,
sentences.zh: 所以能看到它（督导）可以是某种你和你的主管共同创造的东西，并且随着时间的推移，这真的很好，

sentences.en: you are building up that relationship where if there is something outside the norm, you bring that in and it should be able to exist there.
sentences.zh: 你们正在建立那种关系，如果有什么超出常规的事情，你把它带进来，它应该能够存在于那里。

sentences.en: And you go forward and see how it's best going to help your practice, which they kept referring to.
sentences.zh: 然后你继续前进，看看它如何最好地帮助你的实践，他们一直在提到这一点。

sentences.en: Supervision is to develop yourself and a supervisor to help the people you're with, which is really good to see.
sentences.zh: 督导是为了发展你自己和主管，以帮助你所接触的人，这真的很好。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: Yeah, and I loved the idea of actually using that to link your theory and your practice,
sentences.zh: 是的，我喜欢实际上利用这一点来连接你的理论和实践的想法，

sentences.en: but also explicitly mentioning that you should be – it stopped short of saying compassionately tested, didn't it?
sentences.zh: 但也明确提到你应该——它没说“富有同情心的测试”，对吧？

sentences.en: How did it phrase it?
sentences.zh: 它是怎么表述的？

sentences.en: Let me look that up.
sentences.zh: 让我查一下。

sentences.en: And I liked the idea that it said that supervision could be used to offer AP's intellectual challenge enabling reflection,
sentences.zh: 我喜欢它说督导可以用来为助理心理学家（AP）提供智力挑战，促进反思的想法，

sentences.en: which for me sounds like it's a compassionate challenge as well.
sentences.zh: 这对我来说听起来也是一种富有同情心的挑战。

sentences.en: It's not like we're trying to catch you out.
sentences.zh: 并不是说我们试图抓住你的把柄。

sentences.en: We're trying to help you grow and develop from a respectful stance.
sentences.zh: 我们试图以尊重的态度帮助你成长和发展。

sentences.en: So supervision shouldn't feel like you're being found to be lacking, like it should be – you should hopefully be in your window of tolerance and – well, yes, you should.
sentences.zh: 所以督导不应该让你觉得自己在被挑剔，它应该——你希望应该处于你的“容纳之窗”内，嗯，是的，你应该处于其中。

sentences.en: Let's say that.
sentences.zh: 我们就这么说吧。

sentences.en: In supervision, you should be within your window of tolerance.
sentences.zh: 在督导中，你应该处于你的容纳之窗内。

sentences.en: Let's go there, Luke.
sentences.zh: 我们谈谈这个吧，Luke。

sentences.en: Well, I'm certainly saying that.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我当然是这么说的。

sentences.en: And that it shouldn't feel like you are being grilled.
sentences.zh: 而且它不应该让你觉得自己在被严厉盘问。

sentences.en: You know, that's not the intellectual challenge we're looking for.
sentences.zh: 你知道，那不是我们正在寻找的智力挑战。

sentences.en: Like it's a – it's, yeah, something to help transform you.
sentences.zh: 就像它是一个——它是，是的，某种可以帮助你转变的东西。

sentences.en: So that's even what they say, transformational learning and psychological support, not just that it's, you know, what do you know?
sentences.zh: 所以他们甚至说的是，变革性的学习和心理支持，而不仅仅是，你知道，“你知道什么？告诉我们你知道什么。”

sentences.en: Tell us what you know.
sentences.zh: 告诉我们你知道什么。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的，是的。

sentences.en: I like the window of tolerance.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢“容纳之窗”这个概念。

sentences.en: That's really helpful.
sentences.zh: 这真的很有帮助。

sentences.en: I tend to use that a lot when I'm talking to service users.
sentences.zh: 我和服务对象交谈时往往会经常用到它。

sentences.en: I think it also mentioned – I can't find it right now – but it mentioned the zones of proximal development, which is something I tend to think of as well.
sentences.zh: 我想它还提到了——我现在找不到它了——但它提到了“最近发展区”，这也是我倾向于思考的东西。

sentences.en: It's very constructive.
sentences.zh: 它非常有建设性。

sentences.en: It's through the relationship, supervisor and a supervisee.
sentences.zh: 它是通过主管和被督导者之间的关系实现的。

sentences.en: This is where you can get to with the right constructive feedback.
sentences.zh: 这就是你通过正确的建设性反馈所能达到的地方。

sentences.en: Supervision is going to help you get there.
sentences.zh: 督导会帮助你达到那里。

sentences.en: It might be uncomfortable at times, but that's what I, as a supervisor, I'm here to help contain that.
sentences.zh: 有时可能会不舒服，但这就是我作为主管在这里帮助容纳这些情绪的原因。

sentences.en: And if you're struggling, you come to me.
sentences.zh: 如果你在挣扎，你来找我。

sentences.en: We'll figure it out together.
sentences.zh: 我们会一起解决。

sentences.en: It's a joint relationship and it's building upon, what I gather, those foundational elements of what make a psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 这是一种共同的关系，并且正如我所理解的那样，它建立在那些构成心理学家的基础要素之上。

sentences.en: Because, like yourself, when you are qualified, you're going to be plopped in a team or in a service or run your own thing.
sentences.zh: 因为，像你一样，当你获得资格后，你会被投入到一个团队、一个服务机构中，或者经营你自己的事业。

sentences.en: And you're going to have to be able to support staff at the same time as service users, patients.
sentences.zh: 你将不得不既能支持员工，又能支持服务对象和病人。

sentences.en: So it's really good to have these challenges in a safe space, which I suppose is the compassionate side of things.
sentences.zh: 所以在一个安全的空间里进行这些挑战真的很好，我想这就是富有同情心的一面。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: And it should be safe.
sentences.zh: 而且它应该是安全的。

sentences.en: And as I was hearing you talk, I was thinking, oh, Luke's going to be a really lovely supervisor when you're qualified.
sentences.zh: 当我听你说话时，我在想，哦，Luke，当你获得资格后，你会成为一个非常可爱的主管。

sentences.en: Like, because it should almost feel like a nurturing, not parental, but that kind of supportive relationship.
sentences.zh: 因为这几乎应该感觉像是一种滋养，不是父母般的，而是那种支持性的关系。

sentences.en: It should be a little bit like, get behind me.
sentences.zh: 它应该有点像，“站在我身后”。

sentences.en: I've got you.
sentences.zh: 有我罩着你。

sentences.en: Like, if they want you, they're coming through me first, you know, so that you can't be asked to do everything by everybody.
sentences.zh: 就像，如果他们想要你，他们得先通过我，你知道，这样你就不会被所有人要求做所有事情。

sentences.en: And nor can you be, you know, criticised or got at.
sentences.zh: 你也不可能被，你知道，批评或针对。

sentences.en: Like, it should feel like there's someone on your team and kind of on your side.
sentences.zh: 就像，它应该让你觉得有人在你的团队里，站在你这一边。

sentences.en: And, yeah, that is all about looking out for you.
sentences.zh: 而且，是的，这一切都是为了照顾你。

sentences.en: But the training strategies you mentioned, I'm glad you mentioned that.
sentences.zh: 但你提到的培训策略，我很高兴你提到了这一点。

sentences.en: That was page 15.
sentences.zh: 那是第15页。

sentences.en: I'm glad you mentioned that.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴你提到了这一点。

sentences.en: So that's the use of zone of proximal development theory within supervisor supported learning, which is Bynart and Cloacy 2017.
sentences.zh: 这就是在主管支持的学习中使用“最近发展区”理论，即Bynart和Cloacy 2017年的研究。

sentences.en: And when I read that, I was like, yeah, this use of the zone of proximal development theory.
sentences.zh: 当我读到那段时，我就想，是的，这种对最近发展区理论的使用。

sentences.en: And so it's OK, like even at my age and stage of my career to be like, yeah, don't don't really know what that is.
sentences.zh: 所以即使在我这个年龄和职业阶段，也可以说，是的，真的不知道那是什么。

sentences.en: But you've sort of gone into what that is as well.
sentences.zh: 但你已经讲了那是什么了。

sentences.en: So thank you for covering that for our audience, Luke.
sentences.zh: 所以谢谢你为我们的听众涵盖了这一点，Luke。

sentences.en: I'm sure you remember it.
sentences.zh: 我相信你还记得它。

sentences.en: I think it was by Gotsky, if that rings a bell.
sentences.zh: 我想是维果茨基（Vygotsky）提出的，如果这听起来耳熟的话。

sentences.en: It's essentially you work at the boundary, the edge of your ability.
sentences.zh: 本质上是你工作在能力的边界，边缘。

sentences.en: And if you are able to work at the boundary or the edge, then you will make with the right guidance, you will make that leap.
sentences.zh: 如果你能够工作在边界或边缘，那么在正确的指导下，你就会实现那个飞跃。

sentences.en: Whereas if there is too much of a leap, say your supervisor is very, very senior, for example, and you are very, very new.
sentences.zh: 而如果飞跃太大，比如你的主管非常非常资深，而你非常非常新。

sentences.en: That gap is too big.
sentences.zh: 那个差距太大了。

sentences.en: It's too much of a gulf.
sentences.zh: 那是一个太大的鸿沟。

sentences.en: You can't access that next zone or the next ring.
sentences.zh: 你无法进入下一个区域或下一个环。

sentences.en: That's how I viewed it anyway.
sentences.zh: 反正我是这么看的。

sentences.en: I see.
sentences.zh: 我明白了。

sentences.en: So it's not being too overstretched.
sentences.zh: 所以不是被过度拉伸。

sentences.en: It's what is realistic as a next step.
sentences.zh: 而是作为下一步什么是现实的。

sentences.en: Just outside of your comfort zone.
sentences.zh: 就在你的舒适区之外。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: OK.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Just we had to take a little bit of a break in between the first half of that reply and my second half, because my little boy just got back from summer school.
sentences.zh: 我们不得不在那次回复的前半部分和后半部分之间休息一下，因为我的小男孩刚从暑期学校回来。

sentences.en: And he came brandishing a certificate, which I can't show you because it's got the name of the school on.
sentences.zh: 他挥舞着一张证书，我不能给你看，因为上面有学校的名字。

sentences.en: But he said, I've got an award for genuine integrity.
sentences.zh: 但他说是，我获得了一个“真诚正直”奖。

sentences.en: So genuine integrity is one of the school values, and it means to do nice things for other people, even when it's never looking.
sentences.zh: 所以“真诚正直”是学校的价值观之一，意思是即使在没人看的时候，也要为别人做好的事情。

sentences.en: OK.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So I don't know if you heard that, but it's one of the school values is integrity.
sentences.zh: 所以我不知道你是否听到了，但学校的价值观之一是正直。

sentences.en: But actually, this award is for doing nice things for people or doing the right thing, even when nobody's looking.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，这个奖项是为了奖励那些即使在没人看的时候，也为别人做好的事情或做正确事情的人。

sentences.en: And I was like, gosh, isn't that isn't that what we do in the psychology world?
sentences.zh: 我当时就想，天哪，这不就是我们在心理学界所做的事情吗？

sentences.en: And isn't that what we are asking for in our assistant psychologist roles as well?
sentences.zh: 这难道不也是我们在助理心理学家岗位上所追求的吗？

sentences.en: And he's celebrating now.
sentences.zh: 他现在正在庆祝呢。

sentences.en: He's kind of like he's scored a goal.
sentences.zh: 他看起来就像刚进了一个球一样。

sentences.en: But that that matters, doesn't it?
sentences.zh: 但这很重要，不是吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, that's that's brilliant.
sentences.zh: 是啊，这太棒了。

sentences.en: First, I'd say congratulations.
sentences.zh: 首先，我要说声恭喜。

sentences.en: Well done.
sentences.zh: 干得好。

sentences.en: It's clearly getting that from his mother, potentially father as well.
sentences.zh: 很显然，他是从他母亲那里得到的这种特质，可能还有他父亲。

sentences.en: I don't know, but I know he's getting it from you.
sentences.zh: 我不知道，但我知道他是从你这里得到的。

sentences.en: But, yeah, it's really poignant message.
sentences.zh: 不过，确实，这是一个非常深刻的信息。

sentences.en: And much of our work will be sort of behind the scenes.
sentences.zh: 我们的大部分工作都是在幕后进行的。

sentences.en: I'm in a tiny, small office right now on the edge of a ward, just myself.
sentences.zh: 我现在就在病房边上一个极小的办公室里，只有我一个人。

sentences.en: And many assistants and qualifiers will know much of your work is spent in here, preparing, looking at histories and trying to build cases.
sentences.zh: 许多助理和取得资格的人都知道，你们大部分时间都花在这里，做准备、查阅病史并试图建立案例。

sentences.en: And then you go out and interact with the team or the patients.
sentences.zh: 然后你再出去与团队或患者互动。

sentences.en: And it's good for that to be acknowledged, just like your son there, because it is a huge part of the role.
sentences.zh: 能得到认可是一件好事，就像你儿子那样，因为这是工作中非常重要的一部分。

sentences.en: And we get into it knowing that.
sentences.zh: 我们也是带着这种认知进入这个行业的。

sentences.en: And we also want to do that.
sentences.zh: 我们也想这样做。

sentences.en: We want to help others and with or without that recognition, I suppose.
sentences.zh: 我想，无论是否得到认可，我们都希望能帮助他人。

sentences.en: Yeah, and it, you know, it goes beyond, you know, you mentioned the office, but it goes beyond that as well.
sentences.zh: 是啊，而且，你知道，这不仅仅局限于办公室，它涵盖的范围更广。

sentences.en: Like we've got to be making sure that we are speaking respectfully about our clients, even when they're not in the room.
sentences.zh: 比如，我们必须确保在谈论客户时保持尊重，即使他们不在房间里。

sentences.en: And that I think having been part of teams, you know, it can be easy to slip into colloquialisms or less than respectful ways of talking about clients or clients' families.
sentences.zh: 我认为，作为团队的一员，我们很容易陷入使用口语化或不够尊重的言辞来谈论客户或其家属的情况。

sentences.en: And it is a reminder, isn't it, that that integrity runs through all of our interactions when we are wearing our lanyard, you know, and for that matter, when we're not, you know,
sentences.zh: 这确实提醒了我们，当我们佩戴工作证时，诚信贯穿于我们所有的互动中，甚至在不戴工作证时也是如此。

sentences.en: we've got the integrity to uphold the NHS values, even when we're going about our day to day lives, you know.
sentences.zh: 我们有责任维护国民医疗服务体系（NHS）的价值观，即使是在我们的日常生活中也是如此。

sentences.en: And, you know, there's all the separate conversation,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，这又是另一个话题了，

sentences.en: but all the kind of what you should and shouldn't be seen doing when you're wearing a lanyard or even when you are on social media and you've tagged that you work for the NHS.
sentences.zh: 但关于当你佩戴工作证时，甚至当你在社交媒体上标注你在NHS工作时，你应该或不应该做什么，这些都是需要考虑的。

sentences.en: And I think if I could go follow this up a little bit, you just said about using colloquialisms, it made me think of something in my experience.
sentences.zh: 如果我能接着这一点说，你刚才提到的使用口语化表达，让我想起了我经历中的一件事。

sentences.en: The role of psychology, whether it's assistants or a psychologist, I have found is quite well respected in NHS fields, and it's getting more and more respect,
sentences.zh: 我发现心理学这一角色，无论是助理还是心理学家，在NHS领域都相当受尊重，而且这种尊重正与日俱增，

sentences.en: which is great because we need it.
sentences.zh: 这很好，因为我们需要这种尊重。

sentences.en: But with that respect, you know, the whole Ben Parker, great responsibilities with great power comes responsibility and so forth.
sentences.zh: 但正如本·帕克所说，能力越大，责任越大。

sentences.en: And with all that respect we are given, we should remember to do the things you've just mentioned, to uphold the values, to uphold the ethics that we do so believe in,
sentences.zh: 在获得所有这些尊重的同时，我们应该记住去做你刚才提到的那些事情，去维护我们所坚信的价值观和道德准则，

sentences.en: that are all sort of embodied in everything we are doing to try and help others.
sentences.zh: 这些准则体现在我们为帮助他人所做的一切事情中。

sentences.en: And with that extra respect and responsibility we're given, we can kind of stand up and say, actually, to staff, nurses, whoever it may be, let's not talk about them like that.
sentences.zh: 有了这种额外的尊重和责任，我们就可以站出来对员工、护士或其他任何人说：我们不要那样谈论他们。

sentences.en: Let's keep it professional.
sentences.zh: 让我们保持专业。

sentences.en: And in my experience, when that's happened, I haven't been kind of shunned away.
sentences.zh: 根据我的经验，当这种情况发生时，我并没有被排斥。

sentences.en: It's kind of like, oh, yeah, they're right.
sentences.zh: 他们反而会说，哦，是的，你说得对。

sentences.en: They're right.
sentences.zh: 他们是对的。

sentences.en: Because for better or for worse, the fact that psychology is so well known in popular sort of science, popular world,
sentences.zh: 因为无论好坏，心理学在流行科学和大众世界中如此广为人知，

sentences.en: that does bring with it a bit of cachet and a bit of respect that we can use to our advantage at times.
sentences.zh: 这确实带来了一定的声望和尊重，我们有时可以利用这一点来发挥优势。

sentences.en: And it's also what makes it feel so, in my experience, it's what makes it feel so hard when we do feel exploited,
sentences.zh: 根据我的经验，这也是为什么当我们感到被剥削时，会觉得如此难受的原因，

sentences.en: when we don't have the right support behind us, because we think, you know, we are an important role for the patients and for the team.
sentences.zh: 当我们背后没有正确的支持时，因为我们认为自己对患者和团队来说是一个重要的角色。

sentences.en: So, yeah, I think it's a really good point and really useful to use your son as an example there.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我认为这是一个很好的观点，用你儿子作为例子非常贴切。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是这样。

sentences.en: You know, I feel like I'm doing a good enough job.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我觉得我做得已经足够好了。

sentences.en: You know, that's about as much as I have capacity for.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这差不多就是我的能力极限了。

sentences.en: And I think that's all we need.
sentences.zh: 我认为这就是我们所需要的。

sentences.en: That's all we need as parents.
sentences.zh: 作为父母，这就是我们所需要的全部。

sentences.en: It needs to be good enough.
sentences.zh: 它只需要做到足够好就行。

sentences.en: It doesn't need to be exceptional.
sentences.zh: 不需要非得做到卓越。

sentences.en: And maybe my good enough is exceptional for them.
sentences.zh: 也许我的“足够好”对他们来说就是卓越。

sentences.en: I don't know, like a whole other conversation.
sentences.zh: 我不知道，这又是另一个话题了。

sentences.en: Anyway, I'm just conscious of time.
sentences.zh: 总之，我得注意时间。

sentences.en: Are there any other points that you want to kind of draw or bring forward before we close, Luke?
sentences.zh: 卢克，在我们结束之前，你还有什么想补充或提出的观点吗？

sentences.en: I suppose just from the guidance, it mentioned reflective practice.
sentences.zh: 我想，从指导方针来看，它提到了反思性实践。

sentences.en: And I would have liked to have seen a bit more about that because it is so huge in our discipline.
sentences.zh: 我本来希望能看到更多关于这方面的内容，因为它在我们的学科中非常重要。

sentences.en: So it's good that it's there.
sentences.zh: 所以它能被提及是件好事。

sentences.en: But they went in quite detail with regards to supervision, which I was really pleasantly surprised with.
sentences.zh: 但他们对督导的描述非常详细，这让我感到非常惊喜。

sentences.en: But they didn't leave much for reflection or reflexive practice and the difference between those two things.
sentences.zh: 然而，他们对反思或反身性实践以及这两者之间的区别留下的空间不多。

sentences.en: So that would be a gripe of mine that maybe they could increase or improve in the future.
sentences.zh: 所以，这可能是我的一点抱怨，或许未来他们可以增加或改进这一点。

sentences.en: Yeah, it felt like it had been dropped in as a buzz phrase, but there wasn't much legwork put into what that looks like.
sentences.zh: 是的，它感觉就像是被当作一个时髦词汇塞进去的，但在具体实施层面并没有下太多功夫。

sentences.en: And I think it would have been really nice to have some case study examples about what what is good practice and what isn't good practice.
sentences.zh: 如果能有一些关于什么是好的实践、什么是不好的实践的案例研究，那就太好了。

sentences.en: And, you know, what what are your options if you find yourself in X, Y and Z?
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，如果你发现自己处于某种特定情况下，你有哪些选择？

sentences.en: But maybe that is a maybe that is a this is very much a recruitment document.
sentences.zh: 但也许这只是一份招聘文件。

sentences.en: It's not necessarily hugely useful for someone that happens to find themselves in that role.
sentences.zh: 对于那些恰好处于该职位的人来说，它不一定非常有用。

sentences.en: True.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: Well, I still think that's a great, great idea, actually, because even for recruitment teams,
sentences.zh: 好吧，我仍然认为这是一个非常棒的主意，因为即使对于招聘团队来说，

sentences.en: it would be good to see what is a good what is an intermediate or medium example and what is a bad example for recruitment and for the actual people trying to get their job.
sentences.zh: 能看到什么是好的、中等的以及糟糕的招聘案例，对招聘方和求职者来说都是有益的。

sentences.en: So that's a great, great idea.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个非常棒的主意。

sentences.en: And, you know, maybe maybe someone's listening to this and they'll take your idea forward.
sentences.zh: 而且，也许有人正在听这个节目，他们会把你的想法付诸实践。

sentences.en: I hope they do.
sentences.zh: 我希望他们会这样做。

sentences.en: Well, maybe I'll just do it like that's also an option.
sentences.zh: 好吧，也许我会自己去做，这也是一个选择。

sentences.en: Just before we finished, I realised that we haven't covered what much of the guidance has been put together from.
sentences.zh: 在结束之前，我意识到我们还没有涵盖这些指导方针大部分内容的来源。

sentences.en: And it's from a relatively smallish research study done by the BPS where they sampled people who identify as assistant psychologists,
sentences.zh: 它来自英国心理学会（BPS）进行的一项相对较小的研究，他们抽样调查了那些自认为是助理心理学家的人，

sentences.en: who are British Psychological Society members and the number of respondents for that was three, three, seven, so three hundred and thirty seven.
sentences.zh: 他们都是英国心理学会的成员，受访者人数为337人。

sentences.en: But of that, it gave us some insight into demographics.
sentences.zh: 但从中，我们对人口统计学有了一些了解。

sentences.en: And you kind of observed that, actually, initially you thought that some of the the demographics were changing and maybe a little bit of hope for the future.
sentences.zh: 你曾观察到，实际上你最初认为人口统计数据正在发生变化，这或许给未来带来了一点希望。

sentences.en: But, yeah, like it's hard to it's hard to tell with it being a small sample, but also that it's limited to only BPS members, of course,
sentences.zh: 但是，由于样本量较小，而且仅限于BPS成员，很难判断，当然，

sentences.en: because it might be certain people that are more likely to be members.
sentences.zh: 因为某些人可能更有可能成为会员。

sentences.en: But, you know, of this, they also were sampling how often people were getting supervision.
sentences.zh: 不过，他们也调查了人们获得督导的频率。

sentences.en: And I think it was something like nine people were not getting any at all, which is like, oh, that is awful, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 我想大约有九个人根本没有得到任何督导，这真是太糟糕了，不是吗？

sentences.en: That it brings it into stark reality.
sentences.zh: 这让问题变得非常现实。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think it's really good to see statistics behind it, some some some good data.
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为看到背后的统计数据和一些好的数据是非常好的。

sentences.en: But as you say, it's very small in the grand scheme of things.
sentences.zh: 但正如你所说，从宏观角度来看，样本非常小。

sentences.en: And I think I'd noticed some of the socioeconomics were shifting.
sentences.zh: 而且我注意到一些社会经济状况正在发生变化。

sentences.en: However, then when I read the asterisks at the bottom, the reference, I suppose, it said that they had kind of created their own metrics.
sentences.zh: 然而，当我阅读底部的星号参考资料时，它说他们创建了自己的衡量标准。

sentences.en: They'd taken the data and then they'd post data.
sentences.zh: 他们获取了数据，然后进行了后期处理。

sentences.en: They'd created three metrics to loosely be placed upon different metrics of the working class, middle class and maybe lower middle class or something.
sentences.zh: 他们创建了三个指标，粗略地对应于工人阶级、中产阶级和下中产阶级等不同的阶层。

sentences.en: So even that in itself is a little bit loose.
sentences.zh: 所以这本身就有点随意。

sentences.en: So I don't know how much it is actually changing.
sentences.zh: 所以我不知道情况到底在多大程度上发生了变化。

sentences.en: So it would be good to see more robust statistics, wider, maybe reach out to people who have worked in the profession and who are qualified now as opposed to just APs.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果能看到更稳健的统计数据会更好，范围更广，也许可以联系那些曾在该行业工作过、现在已经获得资格的人，而不仅仅是助理心理学家。

sentences.en: I'm not sure, but it's good to get some stats, but I don't know how far we can take it.
sentences.zh: 我不确定，但能得到一些统计数据是好事，只是不知道我们能从中得出多少结论。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Hearing you speak about asterisks, my husband says that I love small print.
sentences.zh: 听到你谈论星号，我丈夫说我喜欢看小字说明。

sentences.en: And like if I'm watching TV and there's an advert and it says like 67 percent of people preferred this or, you know, yada, yada, yada.
sentences.zh: 比如我在看电视时，如果有一个广告说“67%的人更喜欢这个”之类的，

sentences.en: And then it says this mascara is amazing.
sentences.zh: 然后它说这款睫毛膏太棒了。

sentences.en: It's going to change your lashes.
sentences.zh: 它会改变你的睫毛。

sentences.en: And then I'm like, there's asterisks and it says this advert is filled with lash inserts.
sentences.zh: 然后我就会发现有星号，写着“此广告使用了假睫毛”。

sentences.en: I'm like, I'm outraged.
sentences.zh: 我当时就觉得被冒犯了。

sentences.en: And he's not even noticed the asterisks.
sentences.zh: 而他甚至都没注意到那些星号。

sentences.en: So just is kind of letting it flow over him.
sentences.zh: 他只是让信息流过，没往心里去。

sentences.en: And I'm like, no, it's not fair.
sentences.zh: 而我会说，不，这不公平。

sentences.en: It's not right.
sentences.zh: 这不对。

sentences.en: No, we have to find out where our numbers come from because statistics can be manipulated and used.
sentences.zh: 不，我们必须弄清楚我们的数字来自哪里，因为统计数据是可以被操纵和利用的。

sentences.en: And when you read that, the asterisks at the bottom, you're like, oh, it's not actually that significant really, is it?
sentences.zh: 当你读到底部的星号时，你会觉得，哦，其实并没有那么重要，对吧？

sentences.en: So I can use the data, but it's not really saying what I think it's saying.
sentences.zh: 所以我可以使用这些数据，但它并不能真正说明我所认为的那样。

sentences.en: So absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是这样。

sentences.en: The worst offender is when you're watching shampoo and conditioner adverts and it says versus unconditioned hair.
sentences.zh: 最糟糕的情况是当你观看洗发水和护发素广告时，它会说“与未护理的头发相比”。

sentences.en: And it's like, if I bought myself a really cheap conditioner from, you know, the cheapest brand I could find, I may have similar results to this because, you know,
sentences.zh: 这就像是，如果我买了一瓶我能找到的最便宜的护发素，我可能会得到类似的结果，因为，你知道，

sentences.en: I'm not going to not condition my long hair.
sentences.zh: 我不可能不护理我的长发。

sentences.en: Like, so, yeah, it's, you know, we can skew the stats however we want, can't we?
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我们可以随心所欲地歪曲统计数据，不是吗？

sentences.en: I guess this is the gift and the curse of viewing things analytically.
sentences.zh: 我想这就是以分析视角看待事物的礼物和诅咒吧。

sentences.en: Indeed it is.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: Luke, it's been an absolute pleasure speaking with you again.
sentences.zh: 卢克，再次与你交谈真是太愉快了。

sentences.en: And I was like, let's keep this about half an hour.
sentences.zh: 我本来想把时间控制在半小时左右。

sentences.en: But it's just, it's such a big and important topic that we've not managed that at all, have we?
sentences.zh: 但这是一个如此宏大且重要的话题，我们根本没能做到，对吧？

sentences.zh: 不过，我认为这些是非常有帮助且有趣的对话。

sentences.zh: 显然，我希望这对我来说会有很好的结果。

sentences.zh: 但如果别人看到我谈论这件事，可能会改变他们的结果。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对的。

sentences.en: And I think it will, because I've been in similar positions where I've had sort of surgeries for health reasons and I've tried to cover certain things up.
sentences.zh: 我想会的，因为我也有过类似的经历，因为健康原因做过手术，我也曾试图掩盖某些事情。

sentences.zh: 如果我当时想，哦，这真的没那么重要。
